unresolved: Whether the lost-update interleaving that resurrects a revoked key is reachable in the deployed server depends on the ASGI server's concurrency model for these synchronous endpoints.

local_checks.invariant: CORS allow-list and bounded search parameters on /api/catalog/search; no authentication, no rate limiting
local_checks.result: Route /api/catalog/search registers at api/server.py:248-254 with query params q (max_length=200), kind (Literal['all','drugs','targets']), limit (ge=1, le=50, default=20). CATALOG.search() in api/catalog.py:570-682 performs bounded search over local catalog data (max 50 results, query capped at 200 chars). No authentication check in middleware; route not in RATE_LIMITED_PREFIXES (line 51). CORS allow-list from API_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (lines 54-60). Data returned includes drug names, SMILES, sources, MOA, indications, disease areas, PubChem CIDs, assay counts, and target names, short names, sources, disease, pathogen, protein family, in_domain flag, sequence length, assay counts. The search is bounded and the data is local scientific content the tool is designed to expose; no meaningful enumeration oracle exists since results are bounded (max 50 per query) and the caller already has loopback access to the bridge.

local_checks.invariant: MixRequest validators bound the request, the rate limit bounds request frequency, and the error paths do not disclose local state
local_checks.result: MixRequest bounds drugs to 1-4 items of at most 500 characters and targets to 1-2 items of at most 4000 characters; no value reaches a path, shell or template. The per-client-IP rate limit covers /api/mix, but on the documented loopback deployment every local caller shares the 127.0.0.1 bucket, so one local caller can consume the operator's own allowance. The FileNotFoundError path repeats the predict route's detail=str(exc) pattern.

hardening: The rate limiter buckets by request.client.host, so every caller on the same host shares one bucket (127.0.0.1 on the documented deployment).
